profile.headline: Principal Flight Software Engineer at Hermeus
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Over 24 years of experience in software engineering with a proven track record of adapting and succeeding at technical, tech-adjacent, and leadership roles.  I am passionate about working anywhere in the software development life cycle towards ever higher quality software across a wide variety of OS/hardware platforms. In addition to fluency with popular programming languages like C, C++, Java, and Python, I am an expert Ada programmer, a language that is widely used in safety-critical and embedded systems where catastrophic failure ("glitches" to some) could cost lives.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.locationName: Huntington Beach, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Software Design Engineer working as an Actalent contractor on the Boeing Orca XLUUV program at Huntington Beach, CA.  Fixing software defects revealed by static code analysis using AdaCore's GNAT Pro and GNAT DAS (Dynamic Analysis Suite) with CodePeer.  Writing unit tests to satisfy testing and code coverage requirements using GNATtest and GNATcoverage.  Also providing bash and Python scripting expertise as well as project management support for contracting team.
